title: Two Heads Are Better Than One: Dual-Model Verbal Reflection at Inference-Time

live_model.evidence: Appendix: 'We utilized gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 as the Critic LLM to generate reflection data. The temperature is set as 0.7 and the maximum token generation is limited to 1,024.'

claim.metric: ACC/F1/QWK of the DARS Reasoner with GPT-4 as Critic
